Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You hold your aim through a slow breath, watching the opening appear between your target’s movements.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within your ranged attack’s range.
Duration
Until used or the end of this turn.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires the ranged weapon used by the attack; grants no item.
Limits
Repeated uses do not multiply this card’s benefit on the same recipient or prepared attack. Pay a Maneuver for each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Choose the creature. Gain 1 Boon to your next ranged attack against it this turn. If you move or are moved before that attack, lose this benefit. This grants no attack and does not extend the attack’s range.
